grantCap.note: Specification simulation only. No universal state-grant ceiling verified.

charitableGrantCap.scope: Kazakhstan Khalkyna charitable program, restricted eligibility; not used to infer individual eligibility.

grantDirectionShare2026.scope: Share of 2026-2027 state educational grants directed to engineering and technical directions, on the instruction of the Head of State. Allocation by direction, not an individual applicant’s chance.

bachelorGrantApplications2026.scope: Approximate number of applications to the 2026 bachelor grant competition; about 14 000 more than 2025. Against roughly 75 000 bachelor grants awarded.

serpin2026.scope: More than two thousand 2026-2027 grant holders study at universities in northern, eastern and central Kazakhstan under the «Serpin» project.

kimepTuition2026.scope: KIMEP publishes a per-credit price for 2026-2027 and a recommended 30-36 credits per year; 146 credits are required for the degree.
